selectionPolicy: Public YouTube videos under 120 seconds, selected to cover modality and failure-mode diversity.

sources.selectionReason: Speech-dominant clip with a known description/transcript conflict.
Korean recipe clip combining narration, cooking visuals, and on-screen text.
Very short beauty/skincare clip with sparse evidence.

Health/science claim requiring claim extraction and cautious verification.
Product review requiring product entity, features, and opinion separation.
